topic: Fundamental Duties: kitni hain, kab aayi
subject: Polity
caption:
Fundamental Duties kitni hain? 🤔 Jawaab hai 11, lekin ye ek saath nahi aayi thi!

📜 1976: 42nd Amendment se pehli 10 duties (Article 51A, Part IV-A), Swaran Singh Committee ki sifarish par
🎒 2002: 86th Amendment se 11th duty: 6–14 saal ke bachchon ki padhai
🧠 Trick: 42 pe 10, 86 pe 1
🌍 Idea: USSR se

Comment karo: 11th duty kis Amendment se aayi? A) 42nd ya B) 86th
Save karo revision ke liye 📌 aur Follow karo @sarkari.ki.taiyari

first_comment: Answer: B) 86th Amendment (2002). 11th duty = 6 se 14 saal ke bachchon ko padhai ka mauka dena (Article 51A(k)).
